article.story: TORONTO -- — Auston Matthews scored his 11th goal of the season and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Vancouver Canucks 4-2 on Saturday night to end a two-game losing streak, William Nylander and Teddy Blueger each had a goal and an assist, and Zack MacEwen also scored for Toronto (8-6-2). The Maple Leafs had two wins and two losses on a four-game trip. Brock Boeser and Max Sasson scored for the Canucks (3-12-1). They have one win in their last 13 games. Maple Leafs goalie Anthony Stolarz stopped 26 shots and also had an assist on Blueger’s empty-net goal. Leevi Merilainen made 24 saves for the Canucks. Sasson made things interesting early in the third, drawing the Canucks within a goal. Matthews gave the Leafs a 2-1 lead at 3:47 of the second period, beating Merilainen on the short side after a pretty back-and-forth pass with defenseman Darren Raddysh. Up next Maple Leafs: Host Utah on Tuesday night. Canucks: Host Anaheim on Tuesday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
